takeover_risk_then.outcome: Copilot and similar assistants were already shipping codebase aware features; no source records what happened to Storia.

branding.community_and_virality: GitHub repo with a Discord and a free hosted page offer for repos.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source repo with a community channel, but no press on the brand and the name collides with many Sage products.

pivots.from: Generative AI for film and TV pre-production (StoriaBoard, video editing; dot.la April 2023)
pivots.to: Open source contextual AI pair programmer (Sage)

outcome_analysis: Storia launched in December 2022 selling generative video and storyboard tools to Hollywood, raised about a couple hundred thousand dollars from Madrona Venture Labs, then pivoted by 2024 to Sage, an open source codebase copilot, and joined YC in Summer 2024. The YC directory lists it as Inactive, but no shutdown notice was found and the cause is not public. It faced Copilot and other incumbents. No failure factor is assigned because no source gives a reason.
notes: Company site returned 503. YC says founded 2023, dot.la says launched December 2022. Round amount $250K comes from FundedIQ (single database); dot.la only says a couple hundred thousand and names Madrona Venture Labs. Other aggregators say $500K total, likely including the YC deal, not recorded separately. The pivot date and reason are not sourced. VCBacked says it is no longer operating, unverified.
